# cloudraya_region (Data Source)

Looks up a CloudRaya region by its display name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudraya_region" "main" {
  name = "Jakarta"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Region display name, for example `Jakarta`.

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Project to query under. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Region identifier (ULID).
- `status_text` (String) Region status.
- `type` (String) Region backend, for example `cloudstack`, `s3` or `cir`.
